description: This file defines the 'Article' controller class within an OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing task-related operations such as generating, listing, retrieving info, and clearing JSON data files related to countries and articles. It interacts with models for tasks, stores, localisation, and filesystem operations.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class handling task generation, listing, country info, and cleanup for articles and localisation data within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates initial task list for articles and country-related tasks across all stores and languages.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing the list of countries for a specific store and language, based on provided arguments.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed info for a specific country, including zones and geo zones, and saves it to a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated country JSON files for all stores and languages.
